name: After Hours #28 — Platform 7
description: Tiles, a yellow line, and a light that might be a train. The bench is practicing patience. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition. Token 28 is unlimited: anyone can mint this loop. After Hours is a 50-piece open edition of looping lo-fi rooms. Each piece is its own unlimited ERC-1155: rain on glass, desk lamps, last trains, and the kind of quiet you can mint forever. Hand-illustrated stills, then animated into 2.4-second analog loops with grain, weather, and lamp flicker.
